protocol.anchor_and_candidates: Fixed original decision, scored first response, five candidates and Piotr choice preserved
protocol.matching: Unchanged replay, prompt, native-probability and pre-dispatch checks
protocol.new_draws: One fresh pair per target; new suffix draws after the saved intervention; no reuse of old response on changed input
protocol.replacement: Both new outcomes used regardless of success; no best-result selection or old-counterpart fallback
protocol.missing: Renewed missing evidence remains eligible/unresolved; original fitter still requires all60 eligible fit pairs
protocol.handoff: Shared frozen threshold required before held-out continuations
protocol.capture_repair: Same3 observation attempts/30-second deadline and matching fields; fixed1s/2s waits between retries

caveat: Recollection targets prior missing evidence, producing a mixed collection history; it does not remove replay-selection or missingness bias.
